_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see crates/modules/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Total storage, in megabytes, one account at this account level may use across chats, attachments and browser data; empty means unlimited.
examples: give base users 500 MB of storage
settings.notes: null means unlimited; the composer sets numbers only, so set unlimited in the JSON file.

settings.description: Folder size, in megabytes, of each agent an account at this account level publishes; empty means unlimited.
examples: limit published agent files to 256 MB
make agents' file space unlimited for operators
settings.notes: null means unlimited; the composer sets numbers only, so set unlimited in the JSON file.

settings.description: How many agents an account at this account level may publish; empty means unlimited.
examples: no published agents for anonymous visitors
settings.notes: null means unlimited; the composer sets numbers only, so set unlimited in the JSON file.

settings.description: Share of the storage limit, in percent, at which users are warned they are running out of space.
examples: tell me earlier when storage is nearly full

settings.description: Whether saved chat text and files are compressed to save space.
How hard saved data is compressed, from 1 (fastest) to 19 (smallest).
Smallest item, in bytes, worth compressing; smaller items are stored as they are.

excluded./compress_idle_days: Reserved for compaction tiers, which are not built yet; changing it has no effect.
excluded./compression/algorithm: Only zstd is supported; not a choice.
excluded./compression/skip_media_types/**: List of already-compressed media types; technical, edited in its JSON file.
